entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, Noir's Persona is friggin' serious[n]business! ...Oh! I meant it like a[n]compliment, though!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But, uh, dude: don'tcha think the[n]Personas these girls got are scary?[n]I better make sure not to piss 'em off...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it was so weird without Mona...[n]I shouldn'ta mouthed off to him[n]as bad as I did.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, but don't tell him I said that, okay?[n]It'd be pretty embarrassin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now that we got that chief director ID,[n]we can keep movin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This Palace is huge—but I guess the[n]building it's based around was huge[n]in the first place.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wouldn't it be awesome to work in[n]a huge-ass building like this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Work until you drop, huh? This place[n]might actually be worse than[n]Kamoshida's training seshes...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're they workin' so hard for,[n]anyho— Oh, right... They don't got[n]a choice.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't care how many times we do it—[n]flyin' around in space without a suit[n]or anythin' freaks me out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet, that was a piece of cake! Let's[n]swipe that treasure and bounce!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, Noir's Persona has fully awakened,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: W-Well, of course! I meant, like, it went[n]exactly as planned! Ahem... I knew it'd[n]happen this entire time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Finding the treasure's gonna be easier[n]than ever, thanks to Futaba getting us[n]the map!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's see, what section would I make[n]a good chief of... Oh, who am I kidding—[n]I'd just hafta be the chairman!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: *sigh* Why's this Palace so big?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I guess it's at least partly since[n]the actual building is really big, too...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Working the employees until they[n]drop... What exactly is Okumura[n]getting out of it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When I'm finally human again, there's[n]nooo way I'm throwing my life away[n]on some job.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think those airlocks... They're makin'[n]me... Blugh... *urp*
You all right there?
Wanna go for another spin?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll be fine... But, thanks, Joker.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wha— Hell no! What kind of monster[n]are you? C'mon, let's just get this[n]over with already!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This ruler could be related to all the[n]breakdowns somehow... We should[n]be extra careful this time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: With Noir's Persona fully awakened,[n]we're way stronger now!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I took a peek at the map—it sure is huge.[n]We may have a long way to go, but let's[n]just try our best!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Chief Clerk... Section Chief... Chief[n]Director... I guess I kinda understand[n]what they all are, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Which one's actually the highest rank?[n]Do you have any idea?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're finally in the right building with[n]the treasure, but we still need to actually[n]find it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if real hamburger factories[n]are like this...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If so... I don't think I can eat them[n]anymore.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All his employees are just robots to[n]him—he even uses his daughter so[n]he can climb his way to the top...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What kind of treasure would a person[n]like that even have?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It feels SO weird to be in zero gravity.[n]My body feels so light, but I can't move[n]around nearly as easily as I expect.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Joker, we have to take that treasure—[n]for Haru's sake, too.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now we're in space, of all places![n]Palaces are absolute treasure troves[n]for my work.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't think this place is Utopia[n]to anyone, based on appearances...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No one performs adequately for[n]anyone THAT strict.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Never in all my days have I seen such[n]a sight... What a shame that I haven't[n]the time to sketch it...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What exactly are they making here?[n]I know full well it's not hamburgers.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The employees in our reality are[n]probably working their own lives[n]away as well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't imagine they led their lives[n]knowing they'd one day be used[n]and disposed of by Okumura.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wonder if the absence of gravity can[n]be utilized in my work... Perhaps this[n]experience will open my eyes to it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We didn't find any information about the[n]plan... What is this utopia he speaks of?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Using his own daughter like she's just[n]some sort of stepstool... We just have to[n]change his heart!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Escape to Utopia? What could that[n]possibly mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It must be tough as a middle manager—[n]having to consider both your boss's[n]demands and your employees' needs...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Going from the outside was a wise idea—[n]it would have taken forever otherwise.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They can't even take a standard break...[n]How are these employees supposed to[n]keep going at that rate?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This Palace is full of shoddy, replaceable[n]robots... That's probably just how[n]Okumura sees his employees.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I get that there's no gravity in space,[n]but... don't you think this Palace is[n]just a bit overboard?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know... I wonder what they were[n]making.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So, Milady is another part of me,[n]correct? But... she has so much[n]power...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *chuckle* Now I can finally contribute.[n]I'll do my best not to let down the[n]Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Even I'm not sure what my father's[n]been thinking...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I do know that we must stop[n]him... Let's keep going, Joker.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We can finally progress. Don't worry,[n]I can keep going—I made up my mind[n]some time ago!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Leaping from one platform to the next...[n]Now that is proper phantom thief[n]behavior.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Making his employees work until they[n]can't function anymore... No leader[n]should ever do that to his workers.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I can't believe the company expects[n]everyone to use themselves up entirely[n]just for this place...
We'll change his heart.
Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mmhm, definitely. As his daughter,[n]it's my responsibility more than[n]anyone else's!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes, thank you—in fact, I feel like[n]I HAVE to do this now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We're so close to being able to change[n]Father's heart! Let's finish off the[n]infiltration route!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Father... I WILL change your heart!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Noir admiring all those female[n]superheroes... I know exactly[n]where she's comin' from!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wanna see the map? Just gimme one[n]sec and I've got you covered!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Way to score an ID, Joker!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You just make me more and more[n]proud to navigate you guys!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Isn't this spaceport amazing!? If only it[n]weren't a Palace—I'd wanna take the[n]grand tour!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No matter how much they work,[n]they never get to see it end...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: These employees are just resources to[n]Okumura, just machines... I hope there[n]aren't too many companies like this.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm SO glad I read that article on outer[n]space the other day!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Although, this is actually just a Palace,[n]so I guess it's not gonna do us any good.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Route secured! Nice work, Joker!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Sinner who is tied to the chains of fate...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You must not dawdle in the real world.[n]Return to your cell and find the strength[n]to resist.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Your must continue to resist in order[n]to change your fate...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Heehee! Do you really have the time[n]to fool around?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Get back in the pokey and challenge[n]your fate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Give it all you got! Your future depends[n]on it!
